ERR_UNDECLARED_AUDIENCE.message: ERR_UNDECLARED_AUDIENCE: percept must declare a non-empty audience

Action.description: Outbound action emitted by Core toward a body capability.

ActionId.description: Opaque identifier of a dispatched action.

ActorId.description: Opaque identifier of an actor (person, soul, or external participant).

AttachmentHandle.description: Opaque attachment reference crossing Waist 1 with zero raw media bytes (`R-37`).

Audience.description: Set of actors that could perceive an event.

BlobPutParams.description: Parameters for `blob/put` out-of-band attachment staging (`60 s` TTL, SHA-256 verified).

BodyId.description: Opaque identifier of a connected body adapter.

BodyState.description: Body availability and capability advertisement carried into Core.

BodyStatus.description: Operational health state reported for a body.

CapabilityDescriptor.description: Descriptor for one capability advertised by a body.

CapabilityFlags.description: Capability behavioral flags declared by a body.

CapabilityId.description: Opaque identifier of a declared body capability.

CapabilitySchemaHash.description: Deterministic hash of a capability's input/output schema (`R-38`).

ChannelId.description: Opaque identifier of a sensed effect channel.

ChannelPrediction.description: Channel prediction / observation tuple `(channel, Δ_obs, Δ_pred)` (`R-09`).

CorrelationId.description: Opaque correlation identifier linking an action and its outcome/reply.

DomainFactKind.description: The six canonical domain facts across Waist 1.

EmbeddingTag.description: Versioned embedding space identifier `(embed_model_ver, dim_d, prompt_regime_id)`.

EventId.description: Opaque monotonic event sequence identifier in the core log.

FModal.description: 10-element structural acoustic/prosody slot `f_modal` (`R-37`, zero emotion labels).

HAct.description: Canonical action digest `H_act` (`R-42`) binding approvals to exact action parameters.

MetaValue.description: JSON value subset for reverse-DNS `_meta` extensions without tying `protocol` to `serde_json`.

ModalitySlot.description: Media modality classification for opaque attachment handles (`R-37`).

OpaquePayload.description: Opaque payload bytes carried unchanged through Core without interpretation.

OrientScore.description: Orientation score `orient(e, l)` toward a participant actor (`R-29`).

OriginActor.description: Actor that originated an event chain; inherited monotonically along `caused_by`.

Percept.description: A body-reported percept carrying the required domain facts and optional numeric/id features.

PerceptEmitParams.description:
Parameters for `percept/emit`, separating transport headers from domain facts.

`audience` is modeled as `Option<Audience>` on the wire so missing or empty
audiences yield `-32006 ERR_UNDECLARED_AUDIENCE` rather than a generic schema error.

PlaceId.description: Opaque identifier of a place where percepts originate or actions land.

ProtocolVersion.description: Semantic major/minor protocol version carried by every message.

Receipt.description: Terminal or held receipt produced for an action.

ReceiptOutcome.description: Five canonical outcomes of an action (`ARCHITECTURE.md` L198).

SensedEffect.description: Optional expected physical/sensor effect declared for a capability (`R-09`).

StateQueryParams.description: Parameters for `state/query` used after body crashes or restarts.

TaggedEmbedding.description: Embedding vector tagged with its model version, dimension, and prompt regime.

Taint.description: Monotonic minimum-trust provenance taint label (`Untrusted < Provisional < Trusted`).

oneOf.description: Lowest trust: external/unverified source or derived from one.

Time.description: Millisecond timestamp from an injected clock (`u64` ms since epoch).

Waist2Call.description: Adjacently-tagged dispatch representation covering all twelve Waist 2 methods.

Waist2Error.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 error object carrying typed Waist 2 failure codes `-32001`..`-32006`.

Waist2ErrorData.description: Optional structured detail payload on a Waist 2 error object.

Waist2Headers.description: Transport-level Waist 2 headers separated from domain facts.

Waist2Method.description: The twelve stateless JSON-RPC 2.0 methods defining Waist 2 (`monoagens.body.v1`).

info.description: Waist 2 stateless JSON-RPC 2.0 wire contract for MonoAgens bodies.
info.title: monoagens.body.v1

methods.name: body/discover
methods.summary: Advertise deterministic body capabilities, places, and supported protocol version.

methods.name: body/heartbeat
methods.summary: Report body liveness and operational status to the gateway.

methods.name: body/shutdown
methods.summary: Request graceful shutdown of a connected body adapter.

methods.name: percept/emit
methods.summary: Emit a body-sensed percept carrying six domain facts and transport headers.

methods.name: action/execute
methods.summary: Dispatch an action to a declared body capability with idempotency_key.

methods.name: action/cancel
methods.summary: Cancel or preempt an in-flight action, triggering an Option A receipt.

methods.name: action/receipt
methods.summary: Deliver a single terminal or held Option A receipt for an executed action.

methods.name: approval/resolve
methods.summary: Resolve a held PendingApproval bound to canonical action hash H_act.

methods.name: question/answer
methods.summary: Deliver a user answer to an outstanding gateway/body question.

methods.name: state/query
methods.summary: Query crash-recovery status (in_flight, terminal receipt, or unknown) for an action.

methods.name: blob/put
methods.summary: Stage an out-of-band binary attachment (>256 KiB, 60 s TTL) with SHA-256 verification.

methods.name: blob/get
methods.summary: Fetch a staged binary attachment by blob_ref with optional SHA-256 verification.
